args.body:
Hi Sam,

Thank you for reaching out. We've received your urgent complaint regarding the Data Export issue and understand this is blocking your users.

We have an open ticket (T-ext-E_CH_2_003) tracking this at high priority and our team is actively working on a resolution. We'll keep you updated as we make progress and will notify you as soon as the issue is resolved.

Apologies for the disruption — please don't hesitate to reach out if you have any additional details to share.

Best regards
